title: PlayStation Top Games
subtitle: A brand-level leaderboard for the PlayStation games with the strongest reported platform sales on Wikipedia.

cityPreview.summary: Best-selling PlayStation games from Wikipedia's platform-specific sales tables.

confidence: Observed 105 rows across 2 Wikipedia best-selling game page(s) on 2026-08-31T08:02:16.882Z. Values are the displayed sold/shipped copy counts from the source tables.
methodology: This story is generated from Wikipedia best-selling video game tables for PlayStation: List of best-selling PlayStation 4 video games, List of best-selling PlayStation 5 video games. The adapter finds tables with game/title and copies-sold columns, converts displayed million-copy values into copy totals, ranks the configured Top 20, and stores StoryOps snapshots so observed history can accumulate over time. When the same game appears on multiple configured platform pages, the adapter sums those platform-specific values into a brand-level total.
